images.caption: Figure 1:SimWAM achieves the best PDMS with substantially lower latency than world-model-based planners on NAVSIM.

Figure 2:Overview of SimWAM. During joint training, the video and action DiTs learn future dynamics and trajectory generation via MoT, while the attention mask restricts the action tokens to the current observation. Only the action DiT is retained for inference and reinforcement learning.
Figure 3:RL training dynamics. The star denotes the imitation checkpoint. Training on the hard subset consistently outperforms training on allnavtrainscenes.
Figure 4:Qualitative comparison ofOurs-ILandOurs-RLon twonavtestscenarios. Red ellipses highlight regions whereOurs-RLprogresses farther while remaining within the drivable area.
